dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Nihon Ishi-kai standard receipt system), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based, Japanese medical billing domain

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical billing (receipt/seikyu) system for Shizuoka city public expense medical care (chiho kohi) - specifically for mother-child household and severely disabled persons medical expense claims (forms 184,185,199,299)
purpose.summary: Batch program that generates medical expense claim documents (seikyu-sho) for local government public expense categories including mother-child households and severely disabled persons. It reads patient and insurance data, calculates totals, and produces printed claim forms with subtotals and grand totals. Part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software suite.

notable_features: 26 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSK1001.INC, CPSK1002.INC, CPHKNJAINF.INC, etc.)
30 CALL statements to ORCA runtime modules (ORCSJOB, ORCSDAY, etc.)
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for batch parameter passing
REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
OCCURS tables for insurance and option parameters
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - file-based I/O with INDEXED organization
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and string literals. Content is clearly readable as COBOL. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 70189 bytes total. Program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used by Japanese clinics.
